visual.title: The same point, different coordinates
visual.caption: The grid is the basis. The coordinates say how far to go along u and along v, so the pair changes when the arrows change even though the point does not.

predict.question: Keep the point where it is and double u. What happens to the coordinate along u?
predict.explain: The point is unchanged, so alpha u has to stay the same total. Doubling u halves the alpha that produces it.
